thread:
maria: Quick sync — Trivera (SI) proposed co-selling via CloudForge marketplace bundled with NimbusHW. Need a simple rules-of-engagement for lead claims + announcement timing. @sanjay @alex

sanjay: +1. Suggestion: escrow queue for marketplace leads. SI gets first-touch window (72h) to qualify; after that, field can claim if SI hasn’t responded. No auto-claim for accounts in field carve.

todd: For crediting: if SI runs the POC -> SI primary credit. If joint demo or handoff before POC -> split 50/50. HW attach uplift: +10% credit to SI if they owned the lead. We should codify this in a matrix.

anne: NimbusHW requires a pre-sales engineer on initial intro for any HW bundle opportunity — that means routing needs a flag so we include PS contact in the inbound notification. Also: hardware quote timelines are longer, factor into SLA.

alex: Timing: propose announcement window Mar 28 — Apr 4 (canary NA then EU). Marketplace listing needs final content + legal signoff by Mar 20. Joint press / blog requires marketing + legal sync.

marketplace-bot: Listing draft uploaded: https://forge.cloud/listings/RED-TRIV-NIM-draft (status: draft). Need final logo + SKU mapping.

deploy-bot: Infra checklist for listing attached. Minimal snippet for mapping table:```
sku,partner,si_owner,region
RED-NIM-BUNDLE-01,Nimbus,Trivera,NA
RED-NIM-BUNDLE-01,Nimbus,Trivera,EU
```

maria: OK — a couple edge rules I'd like to add: 1) "no cold-claim" (SI cannot claim named enterprise accounts that are in field CRM carve), 2) protect co-sell pipeline: SI must attach a 1-sentence qualifying note within 72h or lead auto-rolls to field.

sanjay: Add a small exceptions table for existing contracts and hardware carriers. Also we should define SLA alerts: if SI hasn't acknowledged in 24h generate escalation to partner-ops.

todd: I'll own the lead mapping CSV and the crediting matrix spreadsheet. Will drop by EOD (today).

anne: I'll draft the template intro email for Nimbus + Trivera -> customer, includes PS contact and next steps.

alex: I'll coordinate legal + marketing calendar. Also recommend we do a soft canary listing in CloudForge NA region only for 72h to validate attribution before full rollout.

maria: Action items: todd -> lead_map CSV + credit matrix (due 1764012000), anne -> intro template (due 1764015600), alex -> legal/calendar check + canary plan (due 1764019200). sanjay -> add SLA escalation rules to partner-ops doc. If no objections we’ll publish the internal playbook by Mar 18 and kick off listing work. :thumbsup: 

marketplace-bot: Noted — moving draft to "needs-assets".

deploy-bot: Terraform snippet for automatic tagging (example):```
resource \"forge_listing\" \"red_triv_nim\" {
  name = \"Redwood + Trivera + NimbusHW\"
  sku  = \"RED-NIM-BUNDLE-01\"
  tags = [\"si:Trivera\",\"hw:Nimbus\",\"co-sell\"]
}
```

maria: Thanks everyone — dropping final playbook link here once todd's CSV lands. Ping me if you need carve exceptions.
